note_en: 连…都/也… means "even": 连一个小错误都不放过 "she didn't let even one small mistake slip." 连 goes right before the extreme example, and 都 or 也 must come before the verb; in English "even" alone does the job. The text keeps returning to it, e.g. 连会议记录里的日期格式都要统一 "she wants even the date format in meeting minutes to be consistent."
